what: Kimodo's own foot-contact correction on the person's legs after stood, measured against stood alone (issue #70), 2026-11-06, one rented L4, cloud batch blender-20261106-095757-2939500. One inside for both sides (main 453a2fc8's); the sides differ only in their targets: base = the clip as main plays it (stood alone), new = stood, then Kimodo's foot correction (its post_process_motion with its own foot_contacts labels) on the person's own bones. Definitions (the run's sum.py): 'unpushed' = frames where the ground pushes under 5% of body weight while the vertical residual holds over half of it; 'resF median'/'resF max' = the vertical residual force at the root, absolute, median and largest over frames (N); 'push off weight %' = median of vertical ground reaction force over weight, less 1; 'lowest mm' = the lowest skin point's height over the floor, median and 5th percentile; 'out'/'foot' = percent of bone outside the skin, whole body and foot region; 'joints' = joint-centre error in mm on the path the physics takes (median, max). Not on main when this was copied.
